alias_policy: Time each physical query once; aliases are not extra inference.
compression: On-disk sizes: H5, TAR and NPZ contain different data; their size ratios are not equivalent-content compression trials.
deterministic: Sorted tables and hashes, no report-generation time in content.
interval_calibration: Not calibrated or coverage-scored on private test targets.
official_accuracy: No test GT, leaderboard score, error metric or SOTA claim.
phase_units: Native point_phase/raw_location/q10/q90; TTC outputs in seconds.
quantiles: numpy.percentile(method=linear); physical queries, no alias weighting.
query_resource_alignment: query_time_us is sensor time, not execution UTC; no invented alignment of individual query latency to passive device telemetry.
raw_retention: Report does not delete or regenerate any raw input.
resource_windows: Five-minute UTC bins; observed samples only, no gap filling.
training_ledger: Snapshots may repeat fits and include zero-update re-entry; calendar spans are not active GPU time.
training_losses: Saved stage-specific training objectives, not test errors; loss magnitudes are not directly comparable across different stages.
wall_timing: Recorded eager predict() with caches and read-only hooks; excludes diagnostic writes, model initialization and raw preparation.
